name: serious-stingray
description: A text CTA whose accent rails grow from opposite edges on hover and focus.
purpose: Marks a quiet text action when a filled button would be too heavy but the control still needs a clear hover cue.
bestFor: inline navigation or continue links styled as buttons
secondary CTAs next to a solid primary
avoidFor: primary form submit actions that need a filled hit target
destructive confirms that need a solid warning surface
